rules.statement: A court may grant an interim injunction to protect a legal right where there is a serious question to be tried and the plaintiff has a fair question to raise regarding his existence of a legal right.
rules.supporting_quote: "Moreover, on the face of the plaint the person applying for an injunction must show that he is not bound to fail by virtue of some apparent defect. (Row on Injunctions 6th edition at page 247)"

meta.parties: Seylan Bank Ltd v. Piyasena And Another
